testcase.name: Scenario: Tab, switch, close, and restore docked browser panels: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/docking-system/docking-system.feature:58:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Tab, switch, close, and restore docked browser panels ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And Appearance Browser is docked on the right ✔ And Material Browser is floating over the workspace ✔ When the user drags the Material Browser title bar onto the Appearance Browser tab strip ✔ Then both browsers occupy one right-side dock region as tabs ✔ And one browser is active while the other remains available ✔ And a single tab bar contains both browser tabs ✔ And the viewport remains visible to the left of the dock region ✔ When the user selects the Appearance Browser tab ✔ Then Appearance Browser contents become visible in the dock region ✔ And the panel presents appearance choices without a second browser tab bar ✔ When the user selects the Material Browser tab ✔ Then Material Browser contents become visible in the dock region ✔ And the panel presents material choices without a second browser tab bar ✔ When the user selects Appearance Browser and closes it from its panel controls ✔ Then Appearance Browser is removed from the tab group ✔ And Material Browser remains visible in the right dock region ✔ When the user opens View and then User Interface ✔ And the user selects Appearance Browser ✔ Then Appearance Browser returns as a tab in the right dock region ✔ And its contents are visible
